items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: I was doing that before I met him.

ctx.x: No, they were just asking for carnival numbers. You know, at that time they wanted a good carnival number. They had numbers about Christmas, they had New Year's, and most of all the holidays.
Now, this guy Erickson, he asked you to do a call with him?
No, he didn't ask me. Not him. I was doing that before I met him.
